estimates.method: Household saving ≈ forgone rent rises: ABS CPI rents +3.6% yr to Sep qtr 2026 × median rent (not fetched; ~A$30k/yr assumed) over 2-yr freeze → ~$1,100/yr first year, ~$2,200 second.
